ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line segment $AB = 21, BC = 15$, and point $M$ is the midpoint of $AC$. What is the length of the line segment $AM$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AB=21$ and $BC=15$,\\
thus $AC=AB-BC=21-15=6$.\\
Since point M is the midpoint of AC,\\
it follows that $AM=\frac{1}{2}AC=\frac{1}{2}\times 6=\boxed{3}$.
